recommendation: Keep this source fix. Follow-up is only needed if the work group later changes the official resource index categories themselves.
issue_request: FHIR-17617 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested a core StructureDefinition extension indicating the display group/category of core resource definitions so clients such as Forge can mirror the official resource list grouping.
initial_application: The issue was originally applied in SVN revision 14551, represented in Git as 687407e2959b695e71aeea5a80596c5b225b36da, which added resource-category capture around the resource list categories. Current source already retained the structuredefinition-category extension on almost all active resource definitions, while the extension definition itself has moved to the FHIR Extension Pack.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists NutritionIntake and DeviceAssociation as active core resources, and source/resourcelist.html places them under Clinical.Care Provision and Clinical.Request & Response respectively. Those two current StructureDefinition XML files were the only active-resource coverage gaps found. Community searches found no Zulip or Confluence evidence that narrows, reverses, or conflicts with the Jira/source interpretation.
reconciliation: Added structuredefinition-category extensions to NutritionIntake and DeviceAssociation using the category values already present in the official resource index. No core extension-definition source was reintroduced because the definition is maintained in the FHIR Extension Pack.
source_changes: source/deviceassociation/structuredefinition-DeviceAssociation.xml: added http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/structuredefinition-category with value Clinical.Request & Response, matching existing XML escaping conventions.
